data: In which of the following years is the number of entries in TrEMBL more than 2e+06?

The question asks for the year when the number of entries in TrEMBL exceeds 2e+06. From the left graph, we can see that the number of entries in TrEMBL increases over time. By examining the data points, we can observe that around 2010, the number of entries in TrEMBL reaches approximately 2e+06. Therefore, the year when the number of entries in TrEMBL exceeds 2e+06 is 2010 or later.
